meta.title: Beamlynx - A database client you can hand to an AI agent
meta.description: Beamlynx is a desktop database client for PostgreSQL, MySQL 8 and SQLite. AI agents query through it, and the columns you mask never reach them.

hero.titleLine2: you can hand to an AI agent.
hero.description: AI agents query your database through Beamlynx. Columns you mask never reach them, and you see every query.
hero.facts: macOS, Windows and Linux · PostgreSQL, MySQL 8 and SQLite · No account · Open source

try.hintJoin: Click JOIN above {{table}} to see the tables it connects to.
try.hintAgent: Now click Agent above the results to see what an AI agent would get for the same query.
try.hintDone: That's what an agent gets: email is xxxxx. Switch to SQL to see why, or start over.
try.sqlWritten_one: {{count}} character of SQL written for you
try.sqlWritten_other: {{count}} characters of SQL written for you
try.hintPickTable: These are the tables Pine found, and the app joins any of them. This demo follows {{table}}.
try.hintWhere: Now click WHERE above {{table}} to filter it.
try.hintPickColumn: Pick a column to filter on, for example unit_price.
try.hintValue: unit_price > 500 is filled in. Press Enter to apply it, or change it first.
try.columnNote: This demo filters numeric columns. The app filters any column.
try.wholeNumber: Use a whole number, like 500. Pine reads a bare number as a whole number.
